faqs.q: How accurate is the AI matching?
faqs.a: Our AI achieves ~90% precision on role-specific matching across 500+ job categories. It continuously improves as your team rates candidates.

faqs.q: Does Hireon integrate with our ATS?
faqs.a: We offer native integrations with Greenhouse, Lever, and Workday — plus a REST API for custom connections.

faqs.q: Can I try it before paying?
faqs.a: Absolutely. The Starter plan is free forever. Growth and Enterprise come with a 14-day free trial, no credit card required.
